prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1367; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a distal radius wrist fracture confirmed on imaging and consistent with the fall-and-impact mechanism described. Physical examination findings, including localized tenderness, swelling, and restricted range of motion, correlate closely with the radiographic findings. Initial management consisted of immobilization and analgesia, followed by a structured course of supervised physical therapy and home exercise instruction. Over 27 visits, treatment progressed in a typical pattern, with visit frequency tapering as grip strength, mobility, and pain improved. Records also note a minor wrist strain several years prior that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billed services reflect the treatment delivered, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. At the most recent visit the patient was discharged with good functional recovery and was advised to return if symptoms recur.
